subject: Unforeseen fire protection field condition: existing sprinkler main conflicting with the

messages.text: Sprinkler crew found the existing sprinkler main conflicting with the new duct routing at Lobby 101; it's similar to the condition noted in last month's inspection log, but this one isn't shown on Fire Alarm Riser Diagram FA-501. We would like this resolved ahead of the next work sequence. There will be a cost impact to address this condition. No broader schedule impact is expected. A response within three business days would be appreciated.
Reroute to clear the conflict at Lobby 101 per the attached sketch; proceed once clearance is confirmed. There will be a cost impact to address this condition.

The extent of the existing sprinkler main conflicting with the new duct routing at Lobby 101 is more than we first reported -- does your direction still cover it? A response within three business days would be appreciated.
